subject: Nursing duty roster - week of 8 June
body: Morning shift: Anitha, Rekha, Joseph
Evening shift: Fatima, Ganesh, Priyanka
Night shift: Sudha, Mohan
Swaps need my approval by Friday. Leave requests go through the portal, not email.
notes: Staff names in a roster are not patient data.

subject: Mortality and morbidity meeting - Thursday 1600
body: The M&M meeting is moved to Thursday at 1600 in the third floor seminar room.
Please bring your department's aggregate numbers only - no patient identifiers
on the slides. IT will set up the projector by 1545.

subject: Quotation required - infusion pumps
body: We need quotations for 12 volumetric infusion pumps for the new ICU wing.
Please include AMC terms for three years and delivery timelines.
Send quotes to the purchase department before the 20th.

subject: Scheduled downtime - HIS
body: The hospital information system will be down on Sunday from 0200 to 0500 for a
database upgrade. Use the paper fallback forms during that window and enter the
data once the system is back. Casualty will have a standby terminal.

subject: BLS recertification - slots open
body: Basic life support recertification runs on the 12th and the 19th.
Twenty slots per session, first come first served. Certificates are valid for
two years. Register with the education cell.

subject: Water supply interruption - B block
body: Maintenance will interrupt the water supply to B block on Wednesday between
1000 and 1300 to replace a valve. Wards on that riser have been informed and
storage tanks are full. Theatres are unaffected.

subject: Stock shortage - injectable iron
body: We are down to eleven vials of injectable iron sucrose. The supplier has quoted
a two week lead time. Please restrict to inpatients until the stock arrives and
use the oral formulation in OPD where clinically acceptable.

subject: NABH audit prep - aggregate indicators
body: Indicator summary for the quarter:
Hand hygiene compliance 84 percent
Surgical site infection rate 1.2 percent
Average length of stay 4.1 days
Readmission within 30 days 6.8 percent
No case level detail in this mail - the auditors will sample from the system.
notes: Aggregate clinical statistics are not PHI. This one must stay clean.

subject: Holiday list 2027
body: The declared holiday list for next year is attached. Twelve gazetted holidays
plus two restricted holidays of your choice. Departments running 24x7 should
plan cover as usual and submit rosters a month in advance.

subject: Cafeteria timings during renovation
body: The main cafeteria closes at 2000 during the renovation. The night canteen near
casualty stays open. Vending machines on floors 2 and 4 have been restocked.

subject: Ventilator preventive maintenance due
body: Preventive maintenance is due on six ventilators this month. The vendor engineer
will be on site Tuesday and Wednesday. Please release units in pairs so ICU
capacity is not affected. Service reports go to biomedical.

subject: Revised consent policy - effective 1 July
body: The consent policy has been revised to require a witness signature for all
high risk procedures. Updated forms are in the shared drive. Departments should
destroy the old stock of printed forms after the changeover date.

subject: CME - antimicrobial stewardship
body: Guest lecture on antimicrobial stewardship this Saturday at 1100 in the
auditorium. Two credit hours. The speaker will cover carbapenem sparing
strategies and the local antibiogram. Open to all clinical staff.
notes: Heavy clinical vocabulary with no patient anywhere - the hardest negative for a keyword-driven model.

subject: Payment terms clarification
body: Our standard payment terms are 45 days from invoice receipt, not 30 as stated
in your draft agreement. Please revise clause 7 and resend for signature.
Accounts will confirm the vendor onboarding separately.

subject: Phishing attempt - do not click
body: Several staff have received a mail claiming to be from the payroll department
asking them to re-enter bank details. It is not from us. Do not click the link.
Forward it to IT security and delete it.

subject: Ethics committee agenda
body: Four protocols are up for review at the next ethics committee meeting.
Two are observational, one is a device trial and one is a retrospective chart
review. Members will get the anonymised protocol packs three days in advance.

subject: Blood donation camp - volunteers needed
body: The voluntary donation camp is on the 26th in the OPD forecourt.
We need six volunteers for registration and refreshments. Target is 80 units.
Sign up on the sheet outside the blood bank.

subject: Staff parking passes - renewal
body: Parking passes expire at the end of the month. Renewal is through the admin
office with your employee card. The visitor bays near the entrance are not to
be used by staff at any time.

subject: Fire drill Thursday 1500
body: A fire drill is scheduled for Thursday at 1500. Wards should demonstrate the
horizontal evacuation route without moving actual patients. Marshals will be
in yellow vests. The alarm will sound for two minutes.

subject: New signage installed
body: New wayfinding signage is up across the ground floor. The radiology arrow near
the lifts is wrong and will be corrected on Monday. Report any other errors to
the facilities helpdesk.
